description: This file defines a set of simple methods in XML format for layout-related content management, including creating, updating, and managing layout content and associated resources in the OFBIZ framework.

methods.name: createLayout
methods.description: Creates a new layout content, sets content and resource fields, and persists them into the database.

methods.name: updateLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout content, checks permissions, and updates related entities.

methods.name: createLayoutText
methods.description: Creates layout text content and associates it with resources and content entities.

methods.name: updateLayoutText
methods.description: Updates existing layout text content with new data, maintaining associations.

methods.name: createLayoutImage
methods.description: Handles uploading an image, creating associated content and data resource entries.

methods.name: createLayoutUrl
methods.description: Creates a layout URL resource and associates it with content entities.

methods.name: updateLayoutUrl
methods.description: Updates layout URL content with new data or associations.

methods.name: createGenericContent
methods.description: Creates generic content from uploaded files or existing content, with logic for mime types and associations.
